blocks.title: Spam filter
blocks.text: Spam filter ghair matloob emails ko inbox se bahar rakhta hai.
Ghair matloob tashheeri emails khud alag folder mein chali jati ya mit jati hain, to aap sirf matloob mail dekhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Agar ahem email spam folder mein chali jaye to kya karein?
blocks.explanation: Pehle jaanch lein ke asli hai, phir 'not spam' mark karein ta ke filter seekhe.

items: Spam filters ghair matloob mail ko inbox se alag karte hain.
